snippet.title: Codename: Room Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Download: https://brandon-macleod.itch.io/codename-room

Hey guys, a while ago I released a demo for a game I've been working on called Codename: Room. That demo only gave people a taste of what's to come in the full version. This teaser aims to show off more of what I've been working on and what to expect in the full version of the game. 

Twitter: https://twitter.com/realBMacleod
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/CodenameRoom/
Email: BrandonMacleodGames@gmail.com
